requirements.public_clause: Given equal-length lists state and basis of binary integers, with length 1 through 5, return the ideal BB84 sender state as a list of [real, imaginary] amplitude pairs in Qiskit's little-endian statevector order. For qubit i, basis[i]=0 uses Z and basis[i]=1 uses X; state[i]=0 or 1 selects |0> or |1> in Z and |+> or |-> in X. Each component must be finite and in [-1,1]. Global phase is allowed. Norm and phase-aligned amplitudes are checked with absolute tolerance 1e-10 and zero relative tolerance. Return the value directly; Qiskit is allowed, but circuit identity and construction are not attested.
